metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: ZEPXIF crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C127 H146 Dy6 N40 O48 2+,C6 H15 N1,10(C1 H4 O1),2(N1 O3 1-),11(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy2 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy6 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy1 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy5 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 4 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 7 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal connectivity is not established from the available bond table. Article card reports molecular formula C143H198Dy6N43O75. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 5 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)), 4 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
